note: hygiene review (visual + calm, measured and looked at) then one fix of every high and medium finding; no re-check (the user)

findings.where: /words/run/ sort mode (Sort what you know), p.meta under the answer buttons, all widths, light+dark; web/words/run/index.html:573
findings.what: The counter shows "-1 / 10 · about 1 min left". `const done = R.items.indexOf(item)` looks up the next-item object, which is a different object from the one in R.items, so it returns -1. Even when the lookup works, the first word would read "0 / 10", which puts a zero on screen.
findings.fix: `const done = R.items.findIndex(i => i.item_id === item.item_id)` and render `${done + 1} of ${tot} · about N min left`.

findings.where: /words/ Collections > MINE group (#colls) and /words/mine/ Share a list menu, all widths; web/words/index.html:202,327 + server words.library (not S9)
findings.what: A list made with '+ New list' (POST /api/words/lists returns 200 and the page toasts 'Made “Unit 3”') never shows up again. /api/words never fills any word's `lists` from the word_lists table, and the Mine group builds W._lists only from the student's own words' `collection`, so a list of library words has no tile anywhere.
findings.fix: Server (outside S9, hand to its owner): merge word_lists membership into each entry's `lists` in words.library. Client: index.html:202 `W._lists = [...new Set(words.flatMap(w => [...(w.lists||[]).filter(l => !BUILTIN_LISTS.has(l)), ...(w.own && w.collection ? [w.collection] : [])]))]`, and at line 327 build each list tile from `words.filter(w => (w.lists||[]).includes(l) || (w.own && w.collection === l))`, not only from own words.

findings.where: Word sheet (/words/?w=account.explanation, also occasion.cause), block 'In an SAT-style question', all widths; server sample builder (not S9)
findings.what: An item labelled MOST NEARLY MEANS shows the passage with a blank ('but his ____ of the riot') and lists the target word itself as choice B ('account'). This is a fill-in-the-blank item mislabelled as most-nearly-means. 2 of the 102 words sampled had it.
findings.fix: Server: build 'nearly' items with the word left in the text (underlined) and meanings as the choices, or relabel them as incontext. Page guard in words-ui.js sampleBlock and in run/index.html: if `item.kind === 'nearly' && /_{3,}/.test(item.text)`, show the 'In context' label instead of 'Most nearly means'.

findings.where: /words/print/?id=… worksheet Q3, and meaning→word quiz items generally; server quiz_item distractors (not S9)
findings.what: Distractors come from the same meaning family, so more than one answer is correct: for 'friendly and good-natured' the choices amicable, amiable and congenial all fit, and the key accepts only amiable. A student gets marked wrong for a correct answer.
findings.fix: Server: leave out distractors that share the target's family, synonyms or 'Same as' list (or have a short-meaning overlap). Until that lands, the pages cannot fix it.

fixer_report:
I fixed 28 of the 31 blockers in the files I own; the other 3 still need server work. The S9 check passes, but test_flow does not print "all good": it fails inside `server/checks/s8.py` (Compete), which I did not touch. That failure looks date-dependent (details under "Needs another owner"). I changed only web files.

Branch v2/s9 was rebased onto master (master had only spec commits) and has 6 new commits (9318194..e96f351). Everything is committed and the worktree is detached. Nothing had been fixed before I started. I checked the pages in headless Chromium at 1440, 1280, 900 and 390 with a seeded learner and a fresh one. The dark-theme screenshot came out light, so dark mode is not verified.

**Fixed:**
- **Sort run:** the counter looked items up by object, so it read "-1". It now looks them up by id and reads "1 of 10 · about N min left". The same bug made the flashcard "N left" line and Words check's "Question N of M" wrong, and made "mixed" card fronts ignore the rotation; those are fixed too.
- **Placement and sort answers:** three equal neutral buttons in a 3-column grid, so "Not sure" no longer wraps at 390.
- **Quiz:**
  - Option A no longer gets a focus ring on load; focus goes to the question container and keys still work.
  - The verdict now names the kind of miss instead of repeating the option's rationale.
  - The right count stays hidden until the first right answer.
  - Open word's "O" key is set in the sans font so it doesn't read as 0.
  - "Again today" comes first in the actions row and the dispute link sits apart at the right.
- **Result:**
  - Chips read "account · explanation".
  - When every word shares a date, it is said once in the heading ("all 3 back today").
  - Words due today are taken out of the "tomorrow" count.
  - By type is hidden when the run had one type, and the score is in the sans display font.
  - Up next is "Review N due" / "10 new" / Library, all 44px.
- **"Most nearly means" items with a blank:** the label changes to "In context" and the question becomes the standard complete-the-text wording, in the word sheet sample and in the runner.
- **One orange button per screen:**
  - Library: strip Review and Spread become plain buttons; Flashcards turns orange only once a filter, search or selection is active.
  - Study and My words: Today's words is one line with a plain "Start today's words" button.
